title: Concept: Credential noted in a work comment (universal) — review required
description: A comment noting a credential ((?:TODO|FIXME|XXX|HACK)b[^#n]*(?:password|passwd|secret|toke) distributes the value to every reader and archive of the source. Comments lack the handling controls of secret stores. The remedy is value-free tracking via a secret manager plus a value-free ticket.
risk: Secret persistence in history and checkouts; LOW severity, raised when the value is live.
